title: Implement immutable candidate and final-tag authority
description:
Protected account configuration and a repository-owned fixed-ref primitive form one accepted, narrowly scoped authority contract for candidate and final tags.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Repository-only App, ruleset, environment, immutable-release, and workflow-default configuration is documented and verified with disjoint reviewers and no credential crossover.
- [hard] REQ-02: A versioned primitive is the only implementation path for non-force creation and exact readback of the two constant annotated tag namespaces using one-use repository-scoped credentials.
- [hard] REQ-03: Unit, adversarial, and release-admin acceptance verifies configuration isolation, primitive input/output behavior, revocation, and denial of arbitrary refs, actors, credentials, updates, deletes, or cross-namespace use.
- [hard] REQ-04: The story's children own account configuration, primitive implementation, and joint acceptance separately; no child owns downstream release-execution workflow YAML or creates a tag, release, or candidate byte.

## Notes

Blast radius: the `story:release-authority-foundation` child set; downstream tooling consumes only its accepted fixed-ref interface.
